archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 2. Managing our capacity and workloads​
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Ensuring leaders and teams have a shared, reliable view of who’s working on what, so we can prioritise where people are needed most.​
Priority for pre-Christmas design work but opportunity to refine across January / March. Requirements and new ways of working need to be understood to enable a better understanding of who is working where and how much time / effort is spent on projects. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Strategic prioritisation and triage​ Portfolio, programme and project management ​ Pipeline development ​ Operations oversight​ Human Resources​ Corporate performance monitoring ​ Account and contract management
